text.description_html:
Acorn AI6BP, 13" Smooth Iron Spear Tip Strap Hinge For Interior And Exterior Doors

The 13" Spear Tip Heavy Strap Hinge grants an old world charm to any woodworking project, gate, shutter, entry door, or garage door. Made with a smooth iron finish, this strap hinges feature a spear shaped mounting tip. When installing 3 hinges on a door or gate, these strap hinges are suitable for doors 1-3/8" thick and 32" wide up to 90 pounds. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

Also Available Matching: 10" Spear Tip Heavy Strap Hinge and 17-3/4" Spear Tip Heavy Strap Hinge

Features for the Acorn 13" Spear Tip Strap Hinges:

  • Removable pin and reversible pads for full or half surface application. Includes all necessary hardware.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Specifications for the 13" Spear Tip European Forged Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Using 3 hinges, these are suitable for door 1-3/8" thick and 32" wide up to 90 lbs.
  • Length: 13"
  • Width: 1-5/8"
  • Gauge: .120
  • Pad Width: 1-3/8"
  • Pad Length: 3-1/8"

Sold Individually
